classify.why_this_intent: The query asks for the net cash flow (sum of cash flow amounts) per goal time bucket. The field to be aggregated is CashFlow.amount, which is defined as numeric in the schema.

generate.initial_sparql:
PREFIX wm: <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/>
PREFIX kg: <https://wealth.example.org/kg/>
PREFIX wmmeta: <https://wealth.example.org/metadata/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX schema1: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?bucket (SUM(xsd:decimal(?totalCashFlow)) AS ?netCashFlow)
WHERE {
  # cash flow aggregated per investor
  {
    SELECT ?investorId (SUM(xsd:decimal(?amount)) AS ?totalCashFlow)
    WHERE {
      ?cf a wm:CashFlow .
      ?cf wm:investorId ?investorId .
      ?cf wm:amount ?amount .
    }
    GROUP BY ?investorId
  }
  # investor bucket based on any of their investment goals
  {
    SELECT DISTINCT ?investorId ?bucket
    WHERE {
      ?goal a wm:InvestmentGoal .
      ?goal wm:investorId ?investorId .
      ?goal wm:timeToGoalMonths ?time .
      BIND( IF(xsd:decimal(?time) <= 12, "Short",
            IF(xsd:decimal(?time) <= 60, "Medium", "Long")) AS ?bucket )
    }
  }
  # join on investor
  FILTER(?investorId = ?investorId)  # implicit join
}
GROUP BY ?bucket
ORDER BY ?bucket
